styleguide.intro: Tokens, components and motion for the EiB platform. Colours and fonts come from expatsinbusiness.org; see docs/brand/BRAND.md.

contrast.intro: Every text and background pair used by the design system. Body text needs 4.5:1; borders and focus rings need 3:1.

pairs.focusRingOnWash: Focus ring on muted panels and dialog footers
